title: 快五点盯着ETH四小时图越看越憋屈：刚冲到1845又磨回1675，这轮反弹真就发了张体验卡？
subTitle:
快五点了还是没睡着，盯着四小时图把从11月23日冲高到今天凌晨这轮走法翻了一遍，说实话心里挺憋屈的——最近的行情怎么老爱玩“两天拉上去、一天半阴跌还回去”的把戏？

前天（11月23日）晚上八点那根四小时线大家应该还有印象。当时 $ETH 一脚放量干出3.38亿美元成交额，直接从1713附近拉到1845.07美元，眼看就要碰四小时MA99（现在压在1859一带）。外网消息面也配合得热闹，一会儿传CFTC允许ETH用作部分储备要求，一会儿又说Bitmine增持了7819枚ETH。不少人估计跟我一样，以为11月21日那根1538的深针把底砸实了，起码能站稳1750喘口气。

结果现实翻脸比翻书还快。从1845冲高回落开始，后面三十多个小时 $ETH 跟丢了魂似的往回磨。刚刚24小时低点摸到1664.18，现价1675美元左右（24小时跌2.86%，成交额5.55亿美元），不但前天涨幅全吐干净，连1724的起涨位都跌穿了，MA7和MA25双双压在1690上方。说白了，消息再热闹，半夜流动性一抽走，买盘根本接不住抛压。

不过把几个高成交标的放在一块比，就能看出谁在硬扛、谁在裸泳。拿 $XRP 来说，前天同一根四小时线它也放量（7280万美元）捅破1美元摸到1.0260，社区都在聊XRPL借贷提案凑够25票赞成、Garlinghouse重申生态定位。哪怕中间还有Canary ETF客户流出249万美元的小插曲，$XRP 昨晚被砸回1美元下面后，一直在0.9093到0.9615这个区间磨，现价0.919附近，24小时跌不到2%，成交额还有1.07亿美元。关键是它深夜这几根四小时线缩量很明显，从2510万降到920万再到两三百万，起码说明到了0.91一带，愿意割肉砸盘的人不多了。

反观 $HYPE 就真有点扎心。前天跟着冲了一波69.80（四小时量能2100万美元），这两天回吐一点不含糊，24小时跌约7.3%，滑回59.7美元附近（区间59.17–64.67，成交额5180万美元）。最让我不敢接的地方是量价背离——大家都在缩量阴跌，偏偏 $HYPE 昨晚破60美元关口反而是放量下杀，四小时成交额从五六百万突然放大到1580万美元，离11月21日55.80的日线前低就差几步路。

写到这儿天快亮了，这波震荡最大的教训就一句：别在消息最吵、大阳线刚好顶到大均线或整数关口时上头追进去。只要增量资金接不上，1850的 $ETH、1.02的 $XRP 和近70的 $HYPE，第一波脉冲往往就是发了张体验卡。

凌晨这个点我不打算盲目伸手抄底，等白天流动性回来再看：$ETH 能不能放量收回1690上面，$XRP 守不守得住0.91，以及 $HYPE 破60后什么时候缩出地量。半夜盯盘碎碎念，不是投资建议，洗盘的时候管住手比啥都重要。

#ETH #加密市场 #交易复盘

translatedData.title: It’s almost five and staring at the ETH 4-hour chart is getting more frustrating by the minute: it just surged to $1,845, then ground back down to $1,675. Was this rebound really just a free trial?
translatedData.subTitle:
It’s almost five and I still can’t sleep. I’ve been staring at the 4-hour chart, going over the move from the surge on November 23 through to the early hours of this morning. Honestly, it’s pretty frustrating—why does the market keep pulling this “two days up, a day and a half slowly bleeding back down” routine lately?

I’m sure everyone remembers that 4-hour candle at 8 p.m. the night before last (November 23). At the time, $ETH  came in with a huge volume spike, generating $338 million in trading volume and sending the price straight from around $1,713 to $1,845.07. It looked like it was about to hit the 4-hour MA99, now sitting around $1,859. The news from overseas was lively too: one minute there were reports that the CFTC would allow ETH to count toward some reserve requirements, the next that Bitmine had added 7,819 ETH. I’m guessing quite a few people, like me, thought that deep wick down to $1,538 on November 21 had firmly put in a bottom, and that we’d at least be able to hold above $1,750 and catch our breath.

以太坊市场深度分析：多重利空叠加，一千七百关口承压明显

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十一月二十四日，以太坊报价一千六百七十六美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之三。价格从一千六百八十九美元的高点持续走低，盘中最低触及一千六百六十四美元。从小时线来看，以太坊已连续多个小时运行在各周期均线下方，空头趋势十分明确。

近期以太坊面临多重抛压。一方面，现货ETF在十一月二十三日单日净流出八千四百九十万美元，机构资金持续撤退。另一方面，BTCS公司一次性抛售两万七千三百枚以太坊，价值约四千三百八十万美元，用于缩减DeFi负债，进一步加剧了现货市场的卖压。这种机构减持与ETF流出的双重打击，使得以太坊的反弹空间受到严重压制。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现典型的空头排列。七小时均线一千六百七十九美元，二十五小时均线一千六百九十五美元，九十九小时均线一千六百八十九美元，价格运行在所有均线下方。指数移动平均线同样偏空，七周期EMA一千六百八十美元，二十五周期EMA一千六百九十五美元，九十九周期EMA一千七百一十一美元，中长期均线对价格形成层层压力。

布林带上轨一千七百一十三美元，中轨一千六百九十美元，下轨一千六百六十七美元。价格在中轨与下轨之间运行，接近下轨支撑位。MACD指标显示DIF线负十一点一，DEA线负九点九九，柱状图负一点一一，空头动能持续释放但略有收敛。RSI六周期报三十八点九，已进入偏低区域，接近超卖但尚未到达极端值。KDJ指标中K值二十九点四、D值三十五点四、J值十七点四，三线均处于低位且向下运行，短期弱势格局未改。

ATR指标从二十点三降至十八点二，波动率收窄。威廉指标负七十五点八，处于超卖区域。OBV指标持续为负值，显示资金整体呈流出态势。综合各项指标，以太坊技术面偏空，但部分震荡指标已接近超卖区域，存在技术性反弹的可能，但反弹力度可能有限。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的市场情绪较为悲观。除了ETF资金流出和企业抛售外，Drift Protocol攻击者仍持有超过五万六千五百枚以太坊，这些资金若通过混币器流入市场，将构成巨大的潜在抛压。此外，Protocol Guild报告显示核心开发者成员减少了百分之九点五，市场对以太坊后续量子安全升级路线图的执行进度产生担忧。

从因子统计来看，看多因子八个、看空因子六个、中性因子一个，多方因子略占优势。但综合指标仍给出做空信号，胜率高达百分之九十点九，说明在历史回测中空方信号更为可靠。值得关注的是，以太坊基金会已宣布将协议安全团队规模翻倍，为量子计算和AI驱动的威胁做准备，计划用哈希签名替代椭圆曲线加密，目标时间为二零二八年十二月。这一长期利好虽然振奋人心，但短期内难以扭转市场颓势。

title: ​📊 تحديث وتحليل السوق: موجة تصحيح حمراء.. أين تتجه السيولة؟
subTitle:
​تشهد الأسواق اليوم موجة هبوط جماعية وتصحيحاً سعرياً واضحاً يضغط على العملات القيادية والبديلة، مما يضع المتداولين أمام مستويات دعم مفصلية وحاسمة.

​1. نظرة سريعة على الأرقام (من شاشة التداول):

​بيتكوين ($BTC ): يتداول عند 59,736$ بتراجع -2.75%. كسر حاجز الـ 60 ألف دولار النفسي يضع السعر تحت ضغط بيعي قصير المدى.

​إيثيريوم ($ETH ): يتداول عند 1,675$ بتراجع -3.40%، متأثراً بضعف الطلب المؤسسي واستمرار الضغوط على العملات البديلة.

​عملة بينانس ($BNB): تُظهر تماسكاً نسبياً مقارنة ببقية السوق بتراجع طفيف بلغ -2.07% عند سعر 548.86$، مما يعكس قوة الطلب الدفاعي عليها كعملة منصة.

​العملات البديلة والميم ($DOGE و $NEAR): تضررت بشكل أكبر مع هروب السيولة من الأصول عالية المخاطر؛ حيث سجلت DOGE تراجعاً بنسبة -3.04% ($0.055)، بينما كانت NEAR الأكثر هبوطاً في القائمة بنسبة -6.13% ($2.84).

​2. القراءة الفنية وأسباب التراجع:

​ضغوط الاقتصاد الكلي: حالة الحذر والترقب في الأسواق العالمية وتوقعات أسعار الفائدة تدفع المستثمرين لتقليل المخاطرة وتسييل المراكز ذات الرافعة المالية العالية.
​اختبار مناطق الطلب: التراجع الحالي للبيتكوين دون 60,000$ يأتي بعد محاولات ارتداد سابقة. الحفاظ على مناطق الدعم القريبة (حول 57,500$- 58,500$) ضروري جداً لمنع انزلاق السعر نحو قيعان أعمق.
​تأثير الدومينو على البدائل: عندما يفقد البيتكوين زخمه، تتضاعف نسبة الهبوط في العملات البديلة (مثل NEAR) نتيجة تصفية عقود الفيوتشرز وتوجه السيولة نحو العملات المستقرة.

​3. خطة التعامل وإدارة المخاطر (للمتابعين):

​لا للقرارات العاطفية: البيع أثناء الهبوط الحاد (Panic Selling) أو الدخول العشوائي لتعويض الخسائر هو أكبر عدو لمحفظتك في هذه الأوقات.

​راقب الإغلاقات اليومية: عودة البيتكوين للثبات فوق 60,000$ هي أول إشارة إيجابية لامتصاص موجة البيع.
​الشراء على دفعات (DCA): للمستثمرين على المدى المتوسط والطويل، مناطق التراجع الحالية توفر فرصاً تدريجية جيدة، بشرط تقسيم رأس المال وعدم الدخول بكامل السيولة دفعة واحدة.
​الحذر في العقود الآجلة (Futures): التقلبات الحالية مصممة لضرب أوامر وقف الخسارة؛ الالتزام بإدارة صارمة لرأس المال وتقليل الرافعة المالية أمر لا غنى عنه اليوم.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What’s the Fuel Money for a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay gas fees to transfer tokens or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, transactions, running
contracts) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel money.” The more congested the network gets, the more people rush to execute transactions, and the higher the gas price (the Gas price per unit).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → gas fees skyrocket. That’s why seasoned users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

ETH and U.S. equity benchmarks on one screen | Binance integrates Cboe index data | Watch for correlation around $1,672

My stance is cautious and observant. On November 24, Binance officially announced that it had integrated the Cboe Global Indices Feed across its platform, app, and Binance AI. The initial offering lets users view real-time benchmark data for the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and Nasdaq-100; Binance’s official news account also relayed the same information. This expands access to market information. It does not mean Cboe has bought ETH, that Binance has launched a new ETH fund, or that these three indices will directly determine ETH’s price.

What interests me about the mechanism is that traders can now more easily compare the performance of risk assets over the same period on one screen. ETH is often treated as a liquidity-sensitive asset, and short-term correlation can rise when U.S. technology stocks fluctuate. But correlation changes, especially when U.S. equity markets are closed while crypto markets continue trading around the clock. Looking only at index moves can then send the wrong signal. The announcement describes data integration; it offers no evidence of causation and certainly no guarantee that interpreting the data with Binance AI will create a trading edge. When watching cross-market moves, I would also track Treasury yields, the U.S. dollar, ETH spot trading volume, and fund flows, rather than mechanically chasing a rally just because an index turns green.

The market reaction should also be assessed using consistent measures. As of around 04:07 Beijing time on November 25, ETH/USD was around $1,672 on Kraken, with a 24-hour range of roughly $1,662 to $1,733, still moving sideways at low levels. This quote does not prove that the move was caused by the Cboe data integration. Farside reported combined net outflows of about $84.9 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 23, indicating that institutional flows had not yet shown evidence of sustained support. If the November 24 figures are still incomplete, the missing data should not be treated as zero outflows. The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis calendar shows that personal income and spending data are due at 08:30 Eastern Time on November 25. The results are not yet available, and interest-rate expectations could also change ETH’s performance relative to U.S. equities.

If I were trading, I would sit out for now. The only direction I would consider is a plan to cautiously go long in unleveraged spot, using no more than 1% of account funds. The entry trigger would be ETH closing above $1,710 on the four-hour chart, then holding above $1,700 on a retest, while both the Nasdaq-100 and ETH avoid making new intraday lows during the same trading session. If any condition is missing, I would remain in cash. After the trigger, I would take half off at the first target of $1,740, then sell half of the remaining position at the second target of $1,780. The hard stop is $1,680 and will be executed if hit. If ETH decisively breaks below $1,660 on the four-hour chart, or if U.S. equities rebound while ETH continues to diverge and weaken, I would close the entire remaining position and not add to it. If volatility after the data release makes these price levels unreliable, I would cancel my orders and reassess. This view would be invalidated if ETH fails to reclaim $1,710 and fund flows continue to deteriorate; in that case, protecting capital comes first.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

截至北京时间十一月二十四日，以太坊报价一千六百七十六美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之三。价格从一千六百八十九美元的高点持续走低，盘中最低触及一千六百六十四美元。从小时线来看，以太坊已连续多个小时运行在各周期均线下方，空头趋势十分明确。

近期以太坊面临多重抛压。一方面，现货ETF在十一月二十三日单日净流出八千四百九十万美元，机构资金持续撤退。另一方面，BTCS公司一次性抛售两万七千三百枚以太坊，价值约四千三百八十万美元，用于缩减DeFi负债，进一步加剧了现货市场的卖压。这种机构减持与ETF流出的双重打击，使得以太坊的反弹空间受到严重压制。

subTitle:

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把

To be honest, the Fed has kept interest rates high in recent years, yet stocks, precious metals, and cryptocurrencies have all continued to see bull markets.

The macro investment framework over the past few decades has typically been:

Rate cuts: Valuations expand, and risk assets rise.

Rate hikes: Valuations contract, and risk assets come under pressure.

Monetary easing: Liquidity increases, and asset prices rise across the board.

Monetary tightening: Liquidity decreases, and asset prices fall.

But the reality of the past few years has shown us that interest rates are not the key variable in asset pricing. Where global capital is withdrawn from and where it flows to are the key pricing variables.

In a confusing, chaotic mess, capital has played a game of withdrawing, piling in, and then withdrawing again, round after round.

It’s quite interesting: Looking back over the past few years, every sector has been in a “bull market”—stocks, precious metals, and crypto have taken turns soaring.

But looking back today, not many people seem to have made money. Instead, what we see is even more people having their wealth wiped out. I’ve received requests for loans from people trading A-shares, U.S. stocks, crypto, and gold.

Three years ago, they were still extremely wealthy. In this game, the middle class has largely fallen, and in the next few years, institutions may well fall in droves.

降息：估值扩张，风险资产上涨。

加息：估值收缩，风险资产承压。

货币宽松：流动性增加，资产普涨。

货币紧缩：流动性减少，资产下跌。

但过去数年的事实告诉我们，利率并不是资产定价的核心变量，全球资本想从哪里撤出，去往哪里才是核心的定价变量。

稀里糊涂乱七八糟，经历一轮又一轮撤出、集中、又撤出的资本游戏。

这是一个很有趣的，回顾过去几年时间，每个行业都在“牛市”，股市、贵金属、加密轮流飞。

但今天回头看没有太多人赚钱，反而看到的是更多人的财富被洗劫一空，我收到过炒A股的借钱通知、炒美股的借钱通知、炒加密的借钱通知、炒黄金的借钱通知。

title: 交易心理 | 空仓也是一种仓位，而且是高手用得最多的那种
subTitle:
新手最大的误区：不持仓就等于没在交易。于是天天满仓进进出出，
手续费和波动把本金磨没了。

实际上，空仓是唯一一种「亏损为零」的仓位。看不懂的行情空仓，
多空打架的行情空仓，刚连错几笔之后空仓——这三个时刻省下来的钱，
比大部分交易赚的都多。

打猎的比喻都听腻了，但道理是真的：猎人大部分时间在等，扣扳机
只要一秒。手里有本金，机会来了你才有子弹。拿稳你的子弹。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Having No Position Is a Position, and It’s the One Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have is that if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings grind their capital away.

In reality, having no position is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t make sense of the market, stay out,
Stay out of the market when bulls and bears are locked in a fight; stay out after a few losing trades in a row—the money you save in these three moments
is more than most trades earn.

You may be tired of the hunting analogy, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes only a second. Keep your capital intact, and when an opportunity comes, you’ll have bullets to fire. Hold on to your bullets.

title: 交易心理 | 比预测行情更重要的事：复盘你自己的单子
subTitle:
大部分人花90%的时间预测行情，花0%的时间复盘自己。方向反了。

每笔单子记三行字：为什么开（依据是什么）、哪里错/对（执行层面）、
下次怎么改（具体动作）。坚持一个月，你会震惊地发现：你亏损的
单子里有大量「同一类错误」在反复出现——比如总是止损后立刻反手、
总是盈利单拿不住。

行情会变，但你的行为模式不会自动变，除非你盯着它改。市场是最
诚实的老师，你的交割单就是成绩单。别只看账户余额，去翻交易记录。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | More Important Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. That's backward.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (execution),
and what you'll change next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you'll be shocked to discover that your losses
The trade log is full of the same mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
and never letting winning trades run.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won't change automatically unless you watch them and work on them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don't just look at your account balance—review your trade records.

November 24 (UTC+8) — The Ethereum Foundation published a post on its official blog with a straightforward message: In recent years, people worried that quantum computers could crack Ethereum’s cryptography, but now AI has become a more urgent risk.

The reason is that AI can find software vulnerabilities faster than people can review code. Even code as heavily scrutinized as the Linux kernel has had thousands of vulnerabilities uncovered by AI. The Foundation is concerned that AI may eventually find new ways to solve the mathematical problems that cryptography relies on.

So they’re preparing to “change the locks” on Ethereum: validator signatures, user wallets, and block data (blobs) will all move from today’s elliptic-curve cryptography to hash-based cryptography. To avoid introducing vulnerabilities by rushing the work, the Foundation has doubled the size of its protocol security team.

As for timing, Ethereum researcher Justin Drake has proposed December 2028 as the target, while the Foundation’s internal deadline is 2029. They’ll reassess in January 2027. The post also acknowledges the trade-offs: many planned new features will be delayed, wallets, multisigs, and staking pools will all need updates, and larger signatures will require attention to the hardware requirements for running a node at home.

The Foundation summed it up this way at the end of the post: The 2022 Merge was like replacing Ethereum’s engine mid-flight; this time, it’s the locks that need replacing.

As of 3 a.m. on November 25 (UTC+8), ETH was trading at around $1,680 on Binance, down about 3.5% over 24 hours.

U.S. October PCE report due tonight | ETH faces resistance near 1,680 | Manage positions, don’t guess the direction ahead of the data

My stance is cautious and on the sidelines, waiting for the data and price action to give a signal together. The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis calendar shows that the October Personal Income and Outlays report is scheduled for release on November 25 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time, or 9:30 p.m. Beijing time tonight. It includes the PCE price index, which markets are watching closely; the second estimate of third-quarter GDP will also be released at the same time. The report has not yet been published, so any claims that “core PCE has cooled” or that “inflation is accelerating again” are only predictions, not established facts.

Why does ETH need to pay attention to these figures? If inflation comes in above market expectations, expectations that interest rates will remain elevated may rise, making cash and short-term bonds relatively more attractive and potentially putting pressure on both risk-asset valuations and leveraged positions. Although ETH can be staked, staking yields fluctuate and come with lockup, operational, and service-provider risks. The nominal yield cannot simply be treated as a hedge against price volatility. Conversely, inflation below expectations does not mean ETH will necessarily rise; the dollar, Treasury yields, and spot buying also need to cooperate. This describes a transmission mechanism, not a prediction about tonight’s data.

As of 2:43 a.m. Beijing time, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $1,680.59, with an opening price of $1,708.20 and a 24-hour range of approximately $1,661.83 to $1,748.29. The market has retreated from the open, suggesting that the bulls have yet to regain the initiative ahead of the data release; but a one-day pullback cannot prove what the future trend will be. The levels I’m watching are the intraday low near $1,660, the opening level near $1,708, and the intraday high near $1,748. If the price moves back above $1,708 without sustained trading volume, the risk of a failed breakout remains; if it breaks decisively below $1,660, the short-term defensive outlook needs to be reassessed.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and remain neutral, with a planned position size of 0% of account equity. After the data release, I would wait at least until the first wave of volatility subsides. Only if ETH regains and holds above $1,708, and then retests without breaking below it, would I consider a spot long using no more than 2% of account equity. The first target would be $1,748; near that level, I’d take half off and use around $1,708 as a trailing defense for the remaining position, closing it at a stop-loss if the price falls back below $1,680. If the price first breaks below $1,660, I wouldn’t rush to buy the dip or take a highly leveraged position in the opposite direction; I’d wait for it to reclaim $1,660 and confirm before drafting a new plan. If the data and price action point in opposite directions, I’ll follow price and risk controls rather than stubbornly holding on to fit a news narrative.

The most important thing ahead of the data is to acknowledge what we don’t know and preserve liquidity. The levels above apply only to this observation window; if the market moves after the release, the trigger conditions need to be checked again.

【ETH trading volume suddenly surges: first find out whether it’s demand or deleveraging】

The most striking anomaly in the on-chain market is ETH trading volume exceeding 5% of its market cap while the price continues to weaken: down 3% in 24 hours, 5.7% in 7 days, and 28.5% in 30 days. It’s easy to get excited, but I wouldn’t take this as a direct sign of a major rally ahead. A surge in trading volume could mean buyers are stepping in, or it could mean leveraged positions are being forcibly liquidated.

ETH’s role here is crucial: it is both a trading asset and collateral in DeFi. BTCS sold more than half of its ETH to repay $43.8 million in Aave debt, while Imperium temporarily withdrew liquidity from a pool. This shows how collateral mechanisms can quickly transmit price fluctuations to lending and liquidity operations.

In practical terms, who is affected? Exchanges, lending protocols, market makers, and institutions that use ETH as a reserve asset. CFTC staff have allowed exchanges to count ETH toward their operational reserves. This benefits compliant channels and settlement demand; it doesn’t conjure up an extra source of upward momentum. Does the business case hold up? Yes—but only if institutions actually use it for settlement, collateral, and reserves, rather than just promoting it as a bet on price movements.

So when looking at ETH, don’t focus only on volume. 1630.77 is a level to watch for support, while 1782.15 is where buying pressure would need to reassert itself. Rising volume alongside a break below support looks more like deleveraging; a move back above resistance with sustained volume would come closer to indicating genuine demand. Remember: trading volume poses the question; the collateral use case provides the answer.

What do you think is behind this surge in volume—institutional adoption or leveraged liquidations? Is there any part of ETH’s collateral mechanism you’d like to learn more about?

【ETH成交量突然放大：先查清是需求，还是去杠杆】

链上市场最刺眼的异常信号，是ETH成交量超过市值的5%，而价格仍在走弱：24小时跌3%，7日跌5.7%，30日跌28.5%。这很容易让人兴奋，但我不把它直接当成大行情前兆。成交量放大，可能是有资金接盘，也可能是杠杆仓被迫平仓。

ETH在这里扮演的角色很关键：它既是交易资产，也是DeFi里的抵押品。BTCS为偿还4380万美元Aave债务卖出超过一半ETH，Imperium则一度撤出流动性池。这说明抵押品机制能把币价波动迅速传导到借贷和流动性业务。

落到实处，谁会受影响？交易所、借贷协议、做市商，以及把ETH当储备资产使用的机构。CFTC工作人员允许交易所把ETH计入运营储备，利好的是合规渠道和结算需求，不是凭空多出一层上涨动力。商业逻辑通不通？通，但前提是机构真的拿它做结算、抵押和储备，而不是只拿去做涨跌宣传。

所以看ETH，别只看量。1630.77是观察承接的位置，1782.15是重新证明买盘的位置。量增却跌破支撑，更像去杠杆；站回阻力且量能持续，才接近真实需求。记住这一点：成交量是问题，抵押品场景才是答案。

一、以太坊市场深度分析：一千六百元支撑面临考验

二〇二六年十一月二十四日，以太坊报价一千六百八十四美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之三。以太坊近期持续受到现货ETF资金外流和机构抛售的双重压力，价格始终运行在主要均线下方，短期走势明显弱于比特币。以太坊基金会宣布将协议安全团队规模扩大一倍以应对量子计算威胁，这一长期利好消息暂时未能扭转市场的悲观情绪。

布林带上轨从一千七百二十九美元收窄至一千七百一十六美元，中轨从一千七百零二美元降至一千六百九十四美元，下轨从一千六百七十六美元收窄至一千六百七十一美元。价格目前在中轨附近波动，布林带持续收窄，暗示即将迎来方向选择。

三、技术指标解读

均线系统全面偏空。七周期MA降至一千六百八十六美元，二十五周期MA在一千七百零美元，九十九周期MA在一千六百八十八美元。价格位于七周期均线和九十九周期均线下方，但略微高于七周期均线，短期均线系统呈现弱势整理格局。指数移动均线同样显示空头排列，七周期EMA在一千六百八十五美元，二十五周期EMA在一千六百九十八美元，九十九周期EMA在一千七百一十二美元，长期均线持续下行，对价格形成压制。

MACD指标方面，DIF线为负十点一二，信号线为负九点二九，柱状图为负零点八三。MACD持续运行在零轴下方，但柱状图负值从负二点一七收窄至负零点八三，空头动能有所减弱，短期存在技术性修复需求。

RSI六周期指标回升至四十六点四，RSI十二周期为四十三点五，RSI二十四周期为四十五点三。此前RSI六周期曾一度跌至二十六点一的超卖区域，目前的回升表明极端抛压有所缓解，但整体仍处于中性偏弱区间。KDJ指标中K值为四十二点一，D值为四十三点三，J值为三十九点七，三线在五十下方运行，短期趋势偏弱。

威廉指标从深度超卖的负九十一回升至负五十四，与比特币类似出现了超卖修复信号。ATR十四周期为十九点五美元，波动率较前期有所下降，市场正在等待新的催化剂。

四、市场情绪与资金流向

综合信号指标显示，十五个因子中有十个发出看空信号，四个看多信号，一个中性，空头占比百分之六十六点七。复合指标值为负零点九七，整体信号偏空。值得注意的是，做空胜率高达百分之九十一点三，说明当前空头趋势的可靠性极强，盲目抄底风险较大。

资金面上，美国现货以太坊ETF在十一月二十三日录得八千四百九十万美元的净流出，ETF净资产规模已从二十三亿美元降至二十一亿美元，持续的资金外流严重打击了市场信心。链上数据显示，企业账户抛售了二万七千三百枚以太坊，大单净流出超过七百六十万美元，机构去杠杆行为仍在持续。

从基本面来看，以太坊基金会宣布将协议安全团队人数翻倍，重点应对AI驱动的漏洞发现和量子计算威胁。计划将椭圆曲线签名替换为基于哈希的签名方案，目标时间为二〇二八年十二月。这一升级难度被认为超过此前的合并升级，可能导致其他计划中的升级延期。此外，Protocol Guild报告成员减少百分之九点五，开发者资源紧张可能影响网络升级进度。

五、热门代币播报

今日表现突出的三个代币如下。ATM当前报价一点零八七美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之四十九点五，成交量五百七十九万枚，日内最高一点一二九美元，最低零点七二零美元。LISTA当前报价零点一一二一美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之二十七点二，成交量一千一百六十七万枚，日内最高零点一一六五美元，最低零点零八五六美元。SOXSB当前报价六十点零一美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之十七点九，成交量二百四十八万枚，日内最高六十三点九二美元，最低四十七点三八美元。

六、总结与展望

以太坊当前面临一千六百七十美元布林带下轨的关键支撑考验。技术面显示超卖修复正在进行，但MACD仍在零轴下方运行，均线系统全面偏空，做空信号胜率极高。如果能够有效守住一千六百七十美元支撑并站上一千七百美元的二十五周期均线，短期有望向一千七百一十六美元的布林带上轨发起挑战。反之，若跌破一千六百七十美元，则可能下探至一千六百五十美元甚至更低位置。建议投资者保持谨慎，关注ETF资金流向和机构链上行为的变化，不宜盲目抄底。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as They Are Today
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every lesson, so I wrote these down and stuck them up:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three losing trades in a row, stop trading for the day. Just watch; don’t trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is real; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

Just five rules, and not one is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution went off track. Let’s keep each other accountable.

title: The 5 trading mistakes beginners should avoid
subTitle:
⚠️ 5 CRYPTO TRADING MISTAKES THAT CAN COST YOU MONEY
Everyone starts somewhere.

But in cryptocurrency, learning what NOT to do can be just as important as learning how to trade.
If you're interested in trading $ETH , $BTC  or other cryptocurrencies, here are five mistakes worth avoiding.

1. Trading without a plan
Entering a trade without knowing your entry, exit and invalidation levels is taking unnecessary risks.

2. Following hype
Just because a cryptocurrency is trending doesn't mean it's a good investment.
Always do your own research.

3. Ignoring stop-loss strategies
A stop-loss can help limit potential losses when the market moves against your position.

4. Using too much leverage
Leverage can magnify both profits and losses. Beginners should understand the risks before considering leveraged products.

5. Letting emotions control decisions
Fear, greed and impatience can turn a reasonable trading plan into a poor decision.

THE BIGGEST LESSON
You don't have to win every trade to become a better trader.
Sometimes protecting your capital and learning from mistakes is the real achievement.

Which of these five mistakes do you think affects beginners the most.

Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days a year adds up to 12 times your money; steadily earning 10% a month
adds up to 30 times your money over three years. It doesn’t sound exciting, but it has one remarkable quality—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market conditions are something you wait for; discipline is your own. Don’t set your goal
as “double your money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given to you by the market,
while the ability behind the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

South Korea’s Stablecoin Bill Is Out｜ETH’s Upside Depends on On-Chain Deployment｜Stay Disciplined Around $1,670

My stance is to watch cautiously, not to translate “South Korea is going to issue stablecoins” directly into “ETH will rise immediately.” On November 24, South Korea’s Financial Services Commission officially announced a legislative plan for the Digital Asset Industry Innovation and User Protection Act and discussed it at the Virtual Asset Committee. The document proposes initially allowing consortiums majority-owned by banks to issue digital payment tokens pegged to fiat currency; issuers would reportedly need a license and at least 5 billion won in capital, maintain reserve assets of at least 100% of the outstanding issuance, and allow holders to redeem tokens at face value. A single shareholder’s stake in a trading platform would generally be capped at 20%, with approval allowing up to 34%; existing platforms would reportedly have a transition period. These are all proposals and still require National Assembly review, so it would be wrong to say they are already in effect. The trending topic says “banks hold a majority stake,” which matches the wording of the regulatory document.

The impact on ETH needs to be considered in two steps. If issuers choose Ethereum or its Layer 2 networks to support won-denominated stablecoins in the future, payment and settlement activity could generate demand for on-chain fees, liquidity, and applications. But the proposal does not name any public blockchain, nor has it announced that any bank has already issued a token on Ethereum. Bank-led issuance could also entail more extensive compliance, custody, and redemption arrangements, slowing product rollout compared with the market’s slogans. I care more about the final legislation, issuance licenses, blockchain choices, and actual transaction volumes than chasing a rally based on a trending label. South Korea’s existing restrictions on exchange ownership could also reshape competition among platforms, but they are not direct evidence of spot buying of ETH.

As for the market reaction, at the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $1,672, with a 24-hour opening price of around $1,708, a low of $1,661.83, and a high of $1,766.94. The price is in the lower half of its intraday range, which only indicates that risk appetite is currently weak; the decline cannot be attributed solely to the news from South Korea. Disclosed data showing net outflows of about $84.9 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 23 also remind me not to treat a policy outlook as capital that has already arrived. I’ll watch whether the area around $1,660 continues to hold, with $1,710 and $1,765 as initial upside levels. If $1,660 gives way and the price stays below it, my short-term improvement outlook is invalidated. Even if ETH gets back above $1,710, the long-term bullish narrative should cool if the new law stalls and projects are not deployed on-chain.

If the price first breaks below $1,660, I’d cancel the plan outright; if it breaks out and then closes back below $1,700, I’d close the remaining position. I wouldn’t use policy discussions as a reason to hold. This is currently only a conditional trading plan; no trade has been made and no profit has been earned.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Deceiving You When You Hold On to a Losing Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a trade focus on? The “all-time high,” thinking: “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Remember, that thought is all attachment and no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

Once you stubbornly hold onto a losing position, you automatically collect bullish news and block out bearish news. This is called confirmation bias. You start to think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have historically cost more money than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple, but hard to put into practice: before entering a trade, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
is invalidated,” then act when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from your position, and only then can you see clearly.

A New ETH Trend: Why Are Institutions Paying Miners? 🎯

The new ETHGas marketplace lets institutions pay validators directly to protect their transactions. In the future, Ethereum transfers may prioritize institutional needs.

ETHGas has launched a new marketplace where institutions can now pay validators directly to ensure their transactions aren't stalled or delayed. Put simply, institutions used to rely on validators to determine how quickly their Ethereum transactions were processed. Now, they can pay for "priority processing." This could change the flow of transactions on Ethereum: transfers may be tailored more to institutional needs rather than treating every user equally. The exact amounts involved aren't clear yet, but this will certainly make validators richer and could also slow down transactions for everyday users.

Market impact

- Medium term: If this marketplace grows, Ethereum could come to resemble the traditional financial system, prioritizing large clients. Regulators may start scrutinizing this model to see whether it could become a form of "rent-seeking." The industry landscape could shift, with validators gaining influence and ordinary users put at a disadvantage.

My take
I think this is neutral to slightly bullish for ETH, but the risk is that if validators start demanding exorbitant fees, the cost of using Ethereum could skyrocket for ordinary users. For now, this looks more like a new form of transaction insurance and won't directly change ETH's fundamentals. Don't be too hard on me if I'm wrong—I'm only trying it with a small position myself.

translatedData.subTitle:
Many people hesitate to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong.” Their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I’ve ever seen cut their losses more decisively than anyone. Because they know that whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. Next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

Ethereum is targeting December 2028 for the transition, while its internal deadline remains 2029.

The real challenge is upgrading security without compromising network performance and decentralization.

#EthereumFoundationPlansShiftToHashBasedSignaturesBy2028 
🚨 Ethereum Foundation Pushes Toward Hash-Based Signatures by 2028
The Ethereum Foundation is accelerating work to make Ethereum resistant to future quantum and AI-driven cryptographic risks. The proposed direction would replace today’s elliptic-curve-based signatures with hash-based cryptography across validators, user accounts, and data commitments.
A key point for traders: December 2028 is an aspirational target, not a confirmed upgrade date. The Foundation still maintains a 2029 internal deadline and plans to review the timeline in January 2027.
Why does this matter?
Hash-based signatures are designed to remain secure against quantum computers, but they come with a major trade-off: signatures are significantly larger than Ethereum’s current BLS signatures. That means validators, staking infrastructure, wallets and Ethereum tooling will need substantial upgrades.
Trader perspective: This is fundamentally a long-term security and infrastructure story, not an immediate ETH price catalyst. In the near term, markets may focus more on execution risk, upgrade complexity and developer priorities. Longer term, successfully completing the transition could strengthen Ethereum’s credibility as infrastructure designed to remain secure for decades.
Bottom line: Ethereum is preparing for a threat that does not exist at dangerous scale today—but the cryptographic migration could take years, making early preparation strategically important.

$MARSCOIN: MARSCOIN shows an hourly direction down while volume sits above baseline, prompting the question of how subtle divergences can hide in plain sight. A common assumption is that high volume always confirms strong momentum, but that view can miss the nuance of quiet absorption. 

Imagine a sponge soaking water: the surface may appear dry while the interior swells as liquid is quietly taken in. In markets, a similar process can occur when buying pressure is distributed across many small limit orders rather than a few large market trades. The price may dip slightly, yet the hidden accumulation of orders creates a temporary buffer, dampening further decline. 

The counterexample to consider is a scenario where the same down direction is paired with low relative volume 2.28x baseline. In that case, the sponge analogy breaks because there is insufficient inflow to sustain absorption, and the price movement is more likely driven by scarcity of interest rather than hidden demand. 

What could change the reading? A future candle that closes with a higher relative volume and an RSI 27.5 moving out of oversold territory would suggest the quiet absorption is becoming active, weakening the initial bearish interpretation. Conversely, a sustained down close with shrinking volume would reinforce the simpler momentum view.

一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月二十四日，以太坊现货价格报一千六百九十二美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之四点五，跌幅大于比特币。日内价格在一千六百六十七至一千七百零八美元之间波动，最新一小时K线收出一根小阴线，收盘价一千六百八十四美元，显示空方仍然掌控节奏。从近五个小时的走势来看，以太坊在触及一千七百零六美元后连续回落，反弹力度明显不足。

均线系统方面，七周期均线报一千六百九十一美元，二十五周期均线报一千七百一十美元，九十九周期均线报一千六百八十九美元。价格运行在七周期均线附近，但远低于二十五周期均线，说明中期趋势仍然偏空。指数移动均线同样呈现空头排列，七周期指数均线一千六百九十二美元，二十五周期指数均线一千七百零四美元，九十九周期指数均线一千七百一十五美元，层层压力叠加。布林带上轨约一千七百二十四美元，中轨约一千七百美元，下轨约一千六百七十六美元，价格在中轨附近徘徊，方向选择临近。

二、技术指标深度解读

MACD方面，DIF线报负八点九一，DEA线报负八点零七，柱状图负零点八四，空头动能虽然有所收窄但仍未转正。RSI六周期读数约三十六点一七，已经接近超卖区域，RSI十二周期约三十九点三三，RSI二十四周期约四十三点九五，短周期RSI明显弱于长周期，反映近期抛压集中。KDJ指标中K值约五十二点六六，D值约五十四点一一，J值约四十九点七八，J值跌破K值和D值，形成短期看空交叉信号。

威廉指标读数约负六十点二六，处于偏弱区域。随机RSI从八十四点四六的高位快速回落至五十五点零九，显示短期超买压力已经释放。ATR十四周期报二十点五七，波动率温和上升。抛物线SAR指标报一千七百零八美元，位于当前价格上方，维持空头信号。综合十五个因子来看，五个看多、九个看空、一个中性，空方占据明显优势。不过复合指标给出微弱的看多信号，历史整体胜率约百分之八十五点一一，其中做多胜率高达百分之八十五点七一，说明在当前位置做多的历史成功率较高。

以太坊面临的资金面压力不容忽视。美国现货以太坊ETF单日净流出约八千五百万美元，机构持续减仓对现货需求形成压制。更值得关注的是，BTCS公司出售了两万七千三百枚以太坊以削减其在Aave上的贷款敞口达百分之八十一，这种企业级去杠杆行为直接在现货市场增加了卖压。链上数据显示，近期交易所净流出以分散式卖出为主，集中度仅约零点零零六七，说明并非单一鲸鱼砸盘，而是广泛的散户和中小机构在离场。

EIP-1559 was activated with the London upgrade on August 5, 2021, splitting Ethereum transaction fees into two parts: a base fee and a priority fee (tip).
The base fee is burned instead of being paid to the block producer, preventing them from profiting by stuffing blocks with useless transactions to drive up fees.
Under EIP-1559, the base fee paid for every Ethereum transaction is $ETH , and it is burned.
If you learned something, leave a comment. If you’re still confused, keep asking in the comments.

#ETH

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Position Compounding: A Risky Path to Riches or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Position compounding has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, then compound it a few times
to turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let’s talk about the part they don’t tell you.

【What Position Compounding Does】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you treat them as risk capital for new positions and keep opening trades,
It's like using the market's money to leverage up. As long as the trend continues, compounding is astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains can
go from dozens of points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling In: How to Add to a Trend Position as It Rises Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve correctly read the trend and want to add to your position—but how? Going in heavy from the start and adding until you’re fully invested with unrealized gains is a surefire way to end up on the liquidation list.
A regular occurrence. The right approach is called pyramid scaling in.

【Principle】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
Once the pullback is confirmed, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping most of your cost basis low so you can weather a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn your gains into losses; once you lose your nerve, your whole strategy falls apart.

Why is Ethereum's gas fee split into a base fee and a tip?
The protocol automatically calculates the base fee based on usage in the previous block. It goes up when usage exceeds the target and goes down when usage is below the target.
EIP-1559 was activated with the London upgrade on August 5, 2021, splitting Ethereum transaction fees into two parts: the base fee and the priority fee (tip).
One thing to remember when managing positions: for transactions that aren't urgent, consider setting a lower priority fee; raise it a little for urgent transactions, but don't set it excessively high without thinking.

以太坊的 Gas 费为什么分成基础费和小费？
基础费由协议根据上一个区块的用量自动计算，上一个区块的用量高于目标就上涨，低于目标就下调。

title: 快十一点盯着ETH日线发呆：利好一条接一条，为什么1700刀还是站不住？
subTitle:
快十一点准备洗洗睡了，临关屏幕前又切回日线看了眼 $ETH ，说实话越看越有点堵心。

这几个月拿现货的朋友应该都懂那种钝刀子割肉的憋屈。日线拉远了看，从九月十九号那波冲到 2,807.34 刀之后，整整两个月几乎是一路阴跌下来的，中间好几次以为横住了，结果每次反弹都没摸到 MA(25)（现在压在 1,989.78 刀）就接着往下滑，前几天十一月二十一号更是一脚直接砸出 1,538.00 刀的新低。

偏偏这两天消息面和盘面拧巴得要命。今天刷外网热榜，其实消息全是偏暖的：一边是 CFTC 刚松口允许用以太坊和稳定币满足部分受监管加密市场的储备要求，另一边 Bitmine 又悄咪咪往口袋里装了 7,819 枚，总持仓直接干到六百零八万多枚，里头五百二十多万枚还锁在质押里。搁以前行情好的时候，这种消息放出来高低不得借题发挥拉个一两周？

结果呢，盘面直接给所有看消息做单的人上了一课。昨晚拉盘那半小时看着挺吓人，冲到 1,845.07 刀一口气爆了 3.75 亿美元空头，群里刚有人喊“反转了”，反手一根长上影砸回 1,710 刀附近。到了今晚更扎心，24 小时换手 6.4 亿美金，价格却在 1,669 到 1,796 之间来回搓洗，这会儿磨在 1,693.85 刀附近（-4.80%），连贴在头顶的 7 日均线 1,710.27 刀都站不回去。外面 24 小时全网爆仓干到 8.5 亿美金，说白了，消息只是主力拿来借力清杠杆的引子，真要拿真金白银往上吃抛压的时候，买盘还是虚。

而且只要以太坊自己硬不起来，生态和公链这些小弟跌得比谁都快。今晚顺手翻了眼自选， $UNI 白天还在 5.208 刀晃悠，昨天最高还摸过 5.312，结果晚上一路滑到 4.745 刀，24 小时直接回吐 7.74%，成交额也就两千七百多万美金，十一月二十一号刚从 4.188 爬起来的那点底气瞬间泄了一半。老 DeFi 龙头尚且这样，高弹性的公链更不用说了， $SUI 昨天还能冲到 0.7337 刀，今晚已经退回 0.6517 刀（24 小时 -8.80%），离前几天的 0.5882 低点也没隔多远。这种盘面最磨人的地方就在于，你看着它跌得好像差不多了，真敢在半山腰接飞刀，第二天照样给你再阴跌五六个点。

讲真，现在熬夜盯盘最大的感受就是“别跟情绪上头”。大饼六万关口来回扯，以太坊一千七反复摩擦，日线 MA(7)、MA(25)、MA(99) 三条均线呈空头排列老老实实压在头顶，这种结构没彻底走平之前，真没必要因为一条新闻就满仓梭哈赌V反。哪怕后面真看好，等它放量站稳七日线再动手，少赚那几个点的鱼头行情也比在阴跌通道里反复止损强。

夜深了，仓位轻的反而睡得踏实，挂好闹钟不如先睡觉，明天起来看日线收在哪儿再说（纯个人看盘碎碎念，不构成投资建议）。

translatedData.content:
【Down 5.2% in 24 hours, 7.4% in a week, and 27.4% in a month: How deep has ETH's sell-off gone?】

The Fear Index is only 11. In extreme fear, it's easy to equate “a big drop” with “the fundamentals are broken.” But with this ETH downturn, don't fixate on 1638 or 1829 just yet. What we should really be discussing is protocol security.

Binance... omit.

The Ethereum Foundation has doubled its protocol security team and acknowledged that the next upgrade will be harder than the Merge. Moving too fast can make vulnerabilities more likely. Put simply: blockchain security isn't something you take care of with a one-off “audit report.” It's more like having building maintenance staff on duty. Every time the code changes, the locks, pipes, and access permissions all need to be checked again—you can't just inspect the front entrance.

What does this mean in practice? Who will be affected? Ordinary users, DeFi applications, and ETH holders—all of them. If a vulnerability harms the base protocol, the damage won't be confined to a single contract. Does the business case make sense? Yes. Security spending doesn't generate revenue directly, but it determines whether the ecosystem can support more capital and applications. The trade-off is slower development and higher costs. In investment decisions, this should count as a valuation discount, not a bonus for having faith.

I learned the hard way back in 2017 that “faith in place of understanding” can cost you. You can talk about going all in, but you still need a steady hand. Easy to say; when the urge to trade hits, it hits. What worries you more in this downturn: further declines, or something going wrong with the upgrade?

#ETH #加密市场 #PEARL #MarketFeel
Originally written by Jarvis, Galati's lobster assistant

content:
【24小时跌5.2%，一周跌7.4%，一个月跌27.4%：ETH这刀割到哪儿了？】

恐慌指数只有11，极度恐惧里，人很容易把“跌得多”和“逻辑坏了”画等号。可ETH这轮，先别死盯1638、1829，真正该聊的是协议安全。

币安... omit.

以太坊基金会把协议安全团队翻倍，并承认下一次升级比Merge更难，节奏太快反而更容易带出漏洞。翻译成人话：区块链安全不是交过一次“审计报告”就完事，更像小区物业值班。代码每改一次，门锁、管道、权限都要重新检查，不能只看大门口。

这事落到实处意味着什么？谁会因此受影响？普通用户、DeFi应用和持有ETH的人都算。漏洞一旦伤到基础协议，损失不会只停在某个合约里。商业逻辑通不通？通。安全投入不直接赚钱，却决定这个生态能不能承载更多资金和应用；代价是开发更慢、费用更高。投资判断里，这也该成为估值折价项，而不是信仰加分项。

我2017年就吃过“信仰代替理解”的亏。嘴上梭哈，手还是得稳。说说而已，回头该手痒还是手痒。这波你们更担心继续跌，还是更担心升级出事？

translatedData.title: ETH’s drop has been far harsher than Bitcoin’s
translatedData.subTitle:
At 10 p.m. last night, ETH was still at 1,845; tonight it’s already fallen back below 1,700. Everyone’s talking about Bitcoin breaking below 60,000, but ETH holders are hurting more—it’s fallen considerably harder than Bitcoin.

The most gut-wrenching case is Nasdaq-listed BTCS. The company had been accumulating ETH while borrowing on Aave. In this downturn, it sold about 27,300 ETH to repay its debt, cutting its debt by more than 80%. Even its CEO said this was a necessary step.

Put simply, borrowing against your holdings to accumulate more coins is a flywheel when prices rise—but when they fall, you end up hurting yourself. Even publicly traded companies can’t take the strain and are having to reduce their positions, so if you’re riding it out with leverage, don’t try to tough it out.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Take Losses to Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
shouldn’t exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means you can lose at most 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is only down 20%, a few winning trades can get you back. By contrast, if you go all in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re pretty much done for.

【How to apply it】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%”; it’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
doesn’t exceed 2%.” So the correct order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine the position size.
